lastReleaseMessage: ops layer moves to the private PortfolioOps repo: queue tools become forwarding shims, ops ledgers leave the public tree

barRaise.topFinding: REDACTED: this run's top-finding narrative discusses a HIGH severity security-lens vulnerability. Full detail is in this project's own bar-raise report; withheld from the public copy.

actions.title: Fold the audit-pointer refresh into the same step that runs report retention; Everything.json still names a 2026-08-07 report that no longer exists, now 13 days stale. [CHRONIC x4]

Reword the nightly retention step so it can only prune the second-newest and older of a prefix; it has destroyed the sole surviving report three nights running (Chains 08-18, Scheduler 08-19, Budget 08-20).
Identify which shared script owns report retention and make it write the audit pointer atomically; the fix sits queued twice, once pending since 2026-08-01 and once blocked-on-user.
Delete the blind git-lock removal at collect-usage.ps1:1152-1155; it runs headless every 30 minutes and defeats the Assert-GitSafe live-process check five lines below it.
Rewrite unstick-git.ps1 to call Assert-GitSafe instead of a raw lock delete, and stop git-guard.ps1 pointing recovery at the unsafe script.
Compute queuePending from the queue file instead of hand-typing it; the logged figure is about 280 above the real pending count and three digests drew conclusions from it.
Retire propagate-git-guard.ps1 or repoint it at the PortfolioOps canonical copy; an apply run would overwrite every sibling repo git guard from this repo local copy.
Retire queue-drain-hourly from the registry or accept it reports nothing to do; 0 of 372 pending items are auto-safe, so re-enabling it would process nothing.

Add live milestone markers to the 8 project pages still shipping hand-written prose; the Budget page says milestone six is in progress when its data says done, and the Cattery page says no payments when escrow has been live for months. [CHRONIC x7]
Rewrite the Budget privacy policy out of corporate collective voice; the most trust-sensitive public page in the portfolio reads as if a team stands behind a one-person finance app.
Give Gnosis a tags array so domain lenses run against it; it currently has none, so no voice or concealment lens has ever scanned its public project page.

Rewrite the scheduled task list in .project-context.json to the live registry; all nine named tasks are gone, two lost their folders entirely since last week, and the new routine-health-watch is unlisted. [CHRONIC x17]
Record measured token cost per scheduled run and set a spend ceiling; 2026-08-19 alone burned about 6 percent of this project entire two-month spend with nothing to flag it. [CHRONIC x16]
REDACTED: a HIGH severity finding in the compliance-data-steward lens names a project that is private by rule. Full detail is in this project's own bar-raise report; withheld from the public copy.
Make the projector withhold exploit-shaped security findings by default; the Chains redaction was a one-off manual edit and Cattery.json now carries an equally specific live money-path description.

Confirm the real skill load path and install every skill the nightly routines invoke by name; 18 of 19 staged packages have no folder in the directory this project own docs name as the runtime path. [CHRONIC x16]
Rewrite or retire BAR_RAISE_HANDOVER.md and BAR_RAISE_ROADMAP.md; both describe a task-scheduler shim architecture that no longer exists, in the docs meant to guide incident response. [CHRONIC x23]
Promote one project registry with per-surface visibility flags; the roster is still enumerated in four places. [CHRONIC x17]
Add a schema version and a required-key assertion to check-status-json.ps1 and reconcile Gnosis.json, which ships 10 of the 14 contract keys. [CHRONIC x23]
Trim the public status projection to the fields the cards actually render; over 8,100 lines of project data plus a two-month usage history refetch uncached every five minutes.
Point status/index.html at the aggregate bundle the sibling usage dashboard already uses; the endpoint exists and works, the status page was never wired to it.
Extend the payload-marker and closing-tag checks in push-to-github.ps1 to brackish-rising/index.html; only the Hordes mirror is guarded.
Same guard asymmetry tracked from the gate-publishing side; the two mirrors have also structurally diverged in their decode paths. [CHRONIC x17]
Add docs/ROUTINE_HEALTH.md to .gitignore before the next commit sweep; it names the private projects and every other report type here is already ignored.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Cache-bust the four Apothecary modules reached only by bare static import; a deploy can serve stale copies of them.
Record the working wrangler version and write a durable failure marker when a key-value push exits non-zero; a failed push only prints a console warning.
Add a required-field check to the queue add path in both sanctioned writers.
Constrain the status value to its enum on write; a dead blocked value already had to be hand-normalised once. [CHRONIC x16]
Reject or auto-suffix a duplicate item id on the queue add path.
Add a queue-depth term to the daily governor; depth control currently depends on Kane scheduling a manual cull.

Retire self-reprompt-loop and its breadcrumb file, or rewrite the breadcrumb to the documented shape and wire a trigger; it has no live task and the file was last written 21 days ago by a retired routine in an incompatible shape.
Fix the drain task code sample to import the queue writer from PortfolioOps; it still points at the deprecated shim one line below an instruction saying not to.
Update the hazard catalog path in .project-context.json and both bar-raise docs; they still name a skill-source path that moved out of this repo on 2026-08-19.
Make the always-on top navigation on the homepage a real navigation landmark with a label.
Add entity-encoded dash patterns to the voice checks; the encoded form is confirmed shipping in both hand-authored gate shells right now.
Route the writes in update-project-pages.mjs through write-to-temp, rename and readback; it writes index.html, a file this project names as needing the atomic pattern.
Add a freshness or provenance assertion to check-status-json.ps1; every published status file now originates in a separate local-only repo with nothing here checking the projection is current.
Give the usage-attribution engine automated regression cover; its own header documents 21 successive attribution bug fixes and it has no tests.
Add a same-day threshold check against the trailing weekly average once per-run cost exists.
Settle whether completed items ever leave the hot queue file; 230 of 718 rows are completed history and the runner spec forbids deleting them, so the spec and this finding contradict each other.
Teach the completion-attribution guard to tolerate a routine name as the closer; it fires falsely on at least six legitimate closures on every queue write.
Stamp per-project meta and social tags from status data; the Scheduler page carries v0.7.1 in three meta tags and a heading while its own pill reads v0.7.3.
Restamp the homepage cards; Brackish Rising and Here Be Hordes currently show literal placeholder versions on the live public page.
Scope release commits to an explicit path list. Not independently re-verified this run.
Port the Budget and Scheduler project pages onto the current template, or write down that hand-authored drift is accepted and stop tracking it. [CHRONIC x17]
